active_watches.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Watch issued September 6 at 2:44PM EDT until September 6 at 9:00PM EDT by NWS Greenville-Spartanburg SC
active_watches.description:
THE NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE HAS ISSUED SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH
660 IN EFFECT UNTIL 9 PM EDT THIS EVENING FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS

IN GEORGIA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 4 COUNTIES

IN NORTHEAST GEORGIA

ELBERT                FRANKLIN              HART
STEPHENS

IN NORTH CAROLINA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 7 COUNTIES

IN PIEDMONT NORTH CAROLINA

CLEVELAND             GASTON                LINCOLN
MECKLENBURG           UNION NC

IN WESTERN NORTH CAROLINA

POLK                  RUTHERFORD

IN SOUTH CAROLINA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 12 COUNTIES

IN UPSTATE SOUTH CAROLINA

ABBEVILLE             ANDERSON              CHEROKEE
CHESTER               GREENVILLE            GREENWOOD
LAURENS               OCONEE                PICKENS
SPARTANBURG           UNION SC              YORK

BLACKSTOCK, BOYDVILLE, CALHOUN FALLS, CANON, CATAWBA, CHARLOTTE,
CHESTER, CLEMSON, CLINTON, COLUMBUS, CORNWELL, CROUSE,
DACUSVILLE, EASLEY, ELBERTON, FOREST CITY, FORK SHOALS,
